watch.summary: A streamer passionately reacts and yells instructions at his monitor while watching a Valorant pro match, exploding with excitement when the round is won.

beats.what: Creator screams wildly at the start of the round to hype up his team.
Creator begins aggressively coaching the enemy player through the monitor.
Creator passionately tells Tuyz his 'only job in life' is to play back and stay alive.
The round ends in a win as the target player stays alive and secures the round.
Creator jumps out of his chair shouting in victory.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Your only job in life is to just play back.
watch.why: The humorous element comes from the streamer dramatically backseat-coaching pro players through the screen as if his life depends on it. However, the clip is primarily driven by esports hype rather than pure comedy.
